partII.text: Pick Army Training before each of the first four Part II battles: floors Lv 34, 35, 37, 39
detail: Anyone below a floor auto-levels to it on personal growths only: Part I levels are the real ones
Bench units arrive at their Part I level in the Specialty they earned there
Switching is free afterward, so a side trip can follow at Battle Prep (menu order unverified)

partII.text: Refine every main weapon to +2 before the Ch 12 finale: Part II carries only what units hold
detail: Parts I and II cap at +2 (Renown 10). Refines keep their level in Part III storage.
Part III Blacksmith (Free Time 1) opens every cap with Warrior's Soulstone: Wooden +9, Iron and Bronze +5, specials +3.
Soulstone targets per unit, Cleansing Blades +3 included: the Ledger's refine plan.

partII.text: Bench units keep the Specialty they earned in Part I; Advanced comes on Licenses at the Lv 35 floor
detail: Brigand then [[class:Warrior]]: Simon · Armored Ornius Rider then [[class:Cataphract]]: Nydine
Rogue then [[class:Ranger]]: Nuzzuo · Noctula stays [[class:Pugilist]] (dodge bait)
Alexandra stays Wing Soldier on Bucephalus (Spd 80); she and Lysander fly the Ch 2 Ranger chase

partII.text: From the Lv 35 floor everyone passes Advanced exams; spend Part II Licenses in the Ledger's order
detail: 5 Specialty and 5 Advanced a chapter, no stacking
Ch 1: Simon Warrior, Ninae Guardian, Bonaventure Bishop, plus Ultand, Loretta, Sirocco if Ch 12 missed them
Ch 2: Nydine Cataphract, Nuzzuo Ranger; then side trips where a mastery pays (Sirocco's Bishop, Ch 3)

partII.text: Use spare Specialty Licenses on a skipped Part I side trip (Lysander's Archer, Lilian's Rogue)
detail: No side trip for Tobias, Sofia, Lilian, Lysander, Noctula or Nuzzuo before his Ch 5 Sniper
Noctula stays Pugilist: Warrior needs Sword B, her bane

partII.text: Ch 12 is your last shop: stock Elixirs and Concoctions, since Part II has no shops or free time
detail: Elixirs: Theodora, Tobias, Ultand, Ninae. Everyone else carries a Concoction; Part II Ch 3 asks for plenty
Part II has no recruiting between battles either: plan Ch 10 to 12 around that

partII.text: Don't hoard weapons: Part II repairs every weapon each chapter and issues Iron +3 weapons
detail: Use Combat Arts freely in Ch 12, even if weapons break
An issued weapon may need a free slot?: units at 6/6 use up a consumable or skip it
At 6/6: check Theodora, Tobias, Lysander and Simon on their build pages

partII.text: Buy a [[item:Giant's Ring]] the day the Paralogue accessory shop opens (stock changes each chapter)
detail: The video puts the shop Paralogue in Ch 10 on every path except Leda's, without naming it
Likely Anna's Golden Secret (Ch 11 here, 9/24 to 10/5): unconfirmed

partII.text: Bring all 15: the core 11 plus Nydine, Noctula, Simon and Nuzzuo (Part II deploys up to 15, one source)
detail: Fortress: Theodora, Ninae, Ultand, Tobias, Bonaventure, with Sirocco and Sofia behind
Strike: Alexandra, Lysander, Loretta, Lilian. Flex: Nydine, Noctula, Simon, Nuzzuo
Battalions in Part II are not documented

partII.text: Cover the video's Part II roles: 3–4 physical tanks, 1–2 Res tanks, 2 Physic healers, 2–3 fliers
detail: Physical: Theodora, Ultand, Ninae, Tobias, Simon · Res: Theodora, Ninae, Alexandra · Archers: Lilian, Nuzzuo
1–3 long-range attackers for shields: Lilian (Longbow Deadeye), the two Ovates
Physic: Sofia, Theodora, Ninae · Fliers: Alexandra, Lysander

partII.text: Healing is mandatory on Hard from Part II: keep Sofia, Theodora and Ninae on Physic duty
Part II Ch 2: send Lysander after the southeast Ranger before Turn 4: his Cleansing Blade +1
Blessings (video order): Aurora, then Kalla to Lv 3, Smyrnos to Lv 2, then Mars, Jurah, Credna

partII.group: Part II maps: who answers each
partII.text: Ch 2: Alexandra and Lysander fly after the southeast Ranger before Turn 4; Sirocco backs them
detail: Lysander takes the [[item:Cleansing Blade]] +1 drop. The west Ranger runs from Turn 8 (Horsekiller Bow +1).

partII.group: Part II maps: who answers each
partII.text: Ch 3: the Fortress holds the alleys (Theodora, Ultand, Ninae, Tobias); Sofia and Ninae cast Physic
detail: Every unit carries a Concoction. Gilchris lights fire tiles once he crosses the main road.

partII.group: Part II maps: who answers each
partII.text: Ch 4: Lilian and Nuzzuo shoot the Dragoons, Bonaventure's Cutting Gale helps; Tobias's Triple Spike on elephants
detail: Reinforcements pour up the bridge early: advance slowly.

partII.group: Part II maps: who answers each
partII.text: Ch 5 Dagda: Lilian hits him with [[item:Longbow]] Deadeye (0 damage); Eshmel breaks the shield
detail: Noctula or Loretta baits the Onager and Fire Orb at max range.
Bonaventure and Sirocco hit Dagda's low Res with their [[item:Salamander]]s.
Pull the Golems off their protect tiles first.

partII.group: Part II maps: who answers each
partII.text: Ch 6 Lyrah: Lilian, Nuzzuo and the casters chip the shields; Tobias and Simon hit the cocoon
detail: The cocoon heals on every hit: only big hits once the shields are down.
Part 2: Theodora's group runs the west edge to the exit; the upper-right group holds.

partII.text: Underworld Boon: fight undead within 2 of Eshmel; Tobias, Alexandra, Lysander carry Cleansing Blades
detail: Ultand's Seraphim is the backup; Simon buys his blade in Part III.

partII.text: Offset Curse: unequip cursed gear before hitting undead; the forecast doesn't show the 0
detail: Theodora drops Muen (or Vendetta) for [[item:Mahadu's Spear]] on undead maps.

partII.text: Breza (fliers): bows, no cavalry: Lilian (Bow Hit +15) and Nuzzuo; Nydine sits
Hanno (fog) and Drake (desert): Alexandra and Lysander fly; Sirocco and Bonaventure cast
detail: Credna's Blessing helps on Hanno. No cavalry on either map.

partII.text: Baozi (Pride cuts Hit): Lilian (Bow Hit +15) and Tobias (Battleblade Strike); stay out of the miasma
Cohen & Maria (Lust): Hit and Avo drop vs higher-Cha foes: Ultand, Theodora and Alexandra (Cha 50) lead
Mahadu: spears in the forests: Theodora (Mahadu's Spear) and Lysander. Keep Klapka alive
Balor: 25 deploy, break 8 gates; Tobias and Sirocco strike with Sofia healing beside them
detail: Lyrah first (Fear confuses): chase her west after her first defeat and finish fast.

partII.text: Five Keys of the Diadem sit in Part III chests; every quest and God Request is due 6/6
detail: Keys: Heretics' Cave, Cougar Woodlands, Sand-Shadow Fort, Enno Isle, Giant's-Print Fort.
Divine: Theodora The Trident, Tobias The Godhand, Simon The Eternal, Sirocco The Avatar, Nuzzuo The Calamity, Loretta The Blade.

partII.text: Hold every cursed item at the end of Part I: the Drifting Reliquary re-sells only those
detail: Theodora runs Muen, then Vendetta, on an Underworld Calm loop.
Orchel (Velheit, Gundogya, Anguishing Shield) and Anatolia (Ursa's Right Claw): their build pages own the kit.

extra.text: Pack every unit's Part II kit before Ch 12 ends: main weapon in hand, at most 6 items
detail: Only what a unit holds carries in (the game says "equipped"; read it as its own 6 items?)
Each unit's Ch 12 stage lists the 6; everything else waits in storage until Part III
Keep bows ready for flier-heavy maps

extra.text: Leave Part III items in storage: both Cleansing Blades, Orichalcum, the second Salamander
detail: Tobias takes Theodora's Cleansing Blade, Alexandra Talimun's blade, in Part III
Equipped and carried: Silver Shield (Theodora), Salamanders (Bonaventure, Sirocco), Simon's Hammer
Cursed items stay in storage too: Part III owners are in the Part III list above

extra.text: Take My Late Sister's Accessory if it appears: without it, no Creek in Part II Ch 2 and no Nathan
Hand in every Send Supplies pair for gold and Renown: Cataphract (Ch 8) is Nydine's Part II class
Renown doesn't carry into Part II; Support, Bless Levels and Boons do
